treatment_records.name: azathioprine
treatment_records.reason_stopped: severe nausea and elevated liver enzymes

evidence_notes: Sarah, 34, has had Crohn's for 8 years. Initially misdiagnosed with IBS, she was later diagnosed with Crohn's after a colonoscopy. She tried mesalamine and azathioprine, both of which failed. Her doctor recommended Humira or Remicade. After insurance issues, she started Humira and has been on it for 5 years, achieving remission with occasional flares. She developed psoriasis, possibly related to Humira. She takes vitamin D and B12 supplements. Her overall outcome is partial success due to occasional flares and psoriasis.
